name: Aspect of Lolth
tactics: An aspect of Lolth moves through drow society, hiding its true form beneath the guise of a beautiful drow female. It might reveal its true nature to the priestesses, or it might hide among them, observing their actions and weighing their worth. When drawn into battle, it discards its disguise and reveals its terrible spider form.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: When the aspect of Lolth hits a creature granting combat advantage to it, that creature is weakened and takes ongoing 20 poison damage (save ends both).

powers.name: Worthy Sacrifice
powers.range: Area burst 2 within 10 centered on the chosen ally

effect.description: Choose a nonminion demon, drow, or spider ally within 10 squares of the aspect of Lolth. The chosen ally drops to 0 hit points.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.range: Area burst 2 within 10 centered on the chosen ally

effect.description: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. The zone is difficult terrain, and any nonspider that ends its move within the zone is immobilized (save ends).

The aspect creates a zone in a close burst 1 that lasts until the end of the aspect’s next turn. The zone blocks line of sight for all creatures except the aspect. Any creature other than the aspect is blinded while within the zone.

The aspect alters its physical form to appear as a Medium drow until it uses change shape again or until it drops to 0 hit points. The creature retains its statistics in its new form. Its clothing, armor, and other possessions do not change. To assume a specific individual’s form, the aspect must have seen that individual. Other creatures can make a DC 43 Insight check to discern that the form is a disguise.

powers.name: Impaling Legs
powers.trigger: An enemy moves to a square adjacent to the aspect.
